description: This file defines a final class 'ScreenController' that manages a web view in an iOS app, handling navigation, debugging, and snapshot functionalities for a web-based UI. It includes URL handling, JavaScript evaluation, and state management for the web content.

classes.name: ScreenController
classes.description: A final class managing a web view, navigation, debugging, and snapshot operations within an iOS app, associated with a specific Canvas UI.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Handles navigation to a specified URL string, validating and updating the web view accordingly.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the current web view content based on the current URL string.

methods.name: showDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Resets to the default canvas by clearing the URL and reloading.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display and applies the changes.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Sets the debug title and subtitle, then applies the debug status if needed.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies the current debug status settings to the web view.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Sets the JSON state of the home canvas and updates the web view accordingly.

methods.name: applyHomeCanvasStateIfNeeded
methods.description: Executes JavaScript in the web view to render the home canvas state.

methods.name: waitForA2UIReady
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for the A2UI to be ready within a given timeout.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the context of the web view and returns the result as a string.

methods.name: snapshotPNGBase64
methods.description: Captures a PNG snapshot of the web view, returns a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Captures a snapshot in specified format (.png or .jpeg) with optional quality, returns a base64-encoded string.

methods.name: attachWebView
methods.description: Associates a WKWebView instance with the controller and initializes its state.

methods.name: detachWebView
methods.description: Detaches the WKWebView instance from the controller.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasUIURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a trusted source for the canvas UI.

methods.name: parseA2UIActionBody
methods.description: Parses the body of an A2UI action into a dictionary.
